title: Understanding the Model
text: The model uses a linear regression approach with features for vegetables and types of meat. Adding a random feature can affect the model's bias and variance.

title: Effect of Random Features
text: Adding a feature of random numbers between $$0$$ and $$1$$ does not provide meaningful information related to the prediction task. Consider how this affects the model's ability to generalize.

title: Bias and Variance Trade-off
text: Adding irrelevant features can increase the model's complexity, potentially increasing variance without reducing bias. Think about how this impacts the model's performance.
